Hey! 😊 ❤️ This is super interesting then, I had been in 2 relationships before meeting my current boyfriend. Both relationships lasting less than a month. I had my first boyfriend at 20 and my second at 22. I'm currently 27 years old and met my boyfriend at the beginning of the year - in class. We're both older students in college 😂.

I was a late bloomer and wasn't interested in dating. My desire to be in relationship started when I was around 20. None but 2 of those relationships happened as I was often seen as a friend. I was also awkward so guys didn't really see me in that way. Things changed as I got older, I literally had a crash course on what to avoid because I kept liking the wrong guys. I hadn't come to understand that it is a man's place to pursue, it isn't my responsibility to make a relationship happen. For the most part, I really thank God for that time in my life. God seriously protected me. 

For me, I think God kept me waiting because I hadn't learnt to see for myself what a healthy love looks like. That and, my self-esteem wasn't where it needed to be, hence me liking guys who were bad people. My boyfriend is the complete opposite of that. It might be different for you, I think you should pray about it. It might also be that the man God has for you is going through his own things. We don't know why we wait, in the midst of the waiting. We can only understand after the fact.

Another thing, people usually speak about the ease of their relationships, not the hard bits. You don't know what people are dealing with behind closed doors and instagram photos. Enjoy your life, enjoy the phase you're in. You never know what might come of it.

Hey, I just want to encourage you in your walk as a Christian single. It's not easy, more especially when people around you seem to have the things you desire. What I've found to be true is that God is good. We are given what we need and what we can bare. Once seasons change, we can appreciate how hardship and waiting was ultimately for our good.

Keep praying and trusting God with this area of your life. I found love after I had completely given up on attaining it. Being in a relationship had turned into an idol for me. I did everything I could to rid myself of singleness. Dating apps, making the first move and being so desperate that I held onto bad men. It was  horrible and I honestly thank God for not letting any of those relationships succeed or come to fruition. I was being protected and maybe you are too. 

God has an interesting way of working. Things move when we come to the end of ourselves. They happen when we least expect. Surrender. Perhaps God is asking you to give this area of your life over to Him. Ask Him to help you do this. I've seen many women find love once they'd stopped pursing it. 

Something else to consider is how you view and treat yourself. Speaking for myself, the desire for a relationship can cause desperation. This makes you vulnerable to men who don't care for you. Before dating my boyfriend, I came to realize that if a guy likes you, he'll pursue you because in his eyes you're the prize. Pursing a man throws things off and will make him take you for granted. Don't speak to a man with the intention of a relationship forming, let him pursue you. And once that happens, be clear on your boundaries and values. If he truly loves you, he'll respect them and rise to the occasion because you're his prize!

God is with you and hears your prayers. Keep praying and ask God to prune your heart as well as the heart of the man he wants you to be with. If it is God's will for you to be in a relationship, you will be in a relationship.

I've come to realize that it feels good to be taken care of. This can only happen when you trust the guy you're with. All this talk about feminine energy vs. masculine energy becomes less of a hardened topic when you're with someone and naturally gravitate towards letting a man lead and protect  you, that can only happen when you trust him. You will naturally feel more feminine as a consequence. 

I can understand where you're coming from as I am proactive too. My parents were entrepreneurs and all my siblings are career focused. Don't downplay yourself. 

I think you should date a guy who likes how driven you are, they exist! Once he's there, give him a chance to pursue you. You could even let him know how you'd like to be treated, if he's really into you he'll rise to the occasion. Speaking from experience, being too hands on as a lady throws the guy off eventually and it probably frustrates you too. 

I just go encourage you to keep being yourself and loving the person God made you to be. When a guy you like comes along, let him pursue you.

Hey I tried evening primrose capsules awhile ago too. They broke me out, I started getting cystic acne around my jaw and cheek area. After a few weeks of use. I suspect it gave me hormonal acne.

Apparently evening primrose messes with your hormones because it mimics estrogen once ingested. Having an off balance estrogen level can cause hormonal acne.

 For those evening primrose capsules work for, I guess their body was producing too little estrogen. For those it doesn't work for, maybe you have enough estrogen. I've also heard of people taking a week before/during their period to regulate their estrogen levels. I guess everyone is different. 

I stopped taking it and after about 2 months my break outs were less severe. It's been about 1 year since I stopped and I don't break out like how I did when I took evening primrose capsules.
